label: Open Market — no holds barred
audience_note: Hard mode. Evidence demands at market standard. The tool will tell you your conversion-rate assumption is delusional if it is. No softening. The values-layer rules in SPEC §7 still apply — Open Market does not get to call the baby ugly; it gets to demand more evidence faster.

_dial_docs.score_harshness: 1.4 = scores fall faster, require stronger evidence to rise. Stated/hypothesis confidence get weighted lower than usual.
_dial_docs.novelty_multiplier: 1.5 = push variety hard. Don't repeat content; hammer the founder with diverse angles.
_dial_docs.max_surfaces_per_render: 4 = high cognitive load. Open Market founders signed up for the firehose.
_dial_docs.contradiction_sensitivity: 1.5 = flag even minor inconsistencies. Hold the founder to their own logic.
_dial_docs.anti_pattern_severity_floor: 0.3 = surface every pattern that has even moderate severity. The full library is in play.
